model_annotation: The figure presents two line plots comparing training rewards over steps for two different models—Llama-On-Policy and Llama-LUFFY—on easy and hard training sets. Both plots share a common x-axis labeled "Steps," which ranges from 0 to 500 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 100. The y-axis in both plots is labeled "Training Rewards" and uses a linear scale; in the top plot (Easy Training Set), it ranges from 0.0 to 0.4 with tick marks every 0.1, while in the bottom plot (Hard Training Set), it ranges from 0.0 to 0.2 with tick marks every 0.05. In the top plot, the teal line (Llama-On-Policy-Easy) starts at 0.0 and rises to approximately 0.35 by step 500, with slight fluctuations and a shaded region indicating uncertainty. The red line (Llama-LUFFY-Easy) also starts at 0.0, rises to about 0.4 by step 500, and remains consistently above the teal line after step 100, with a similar shaded uncertainty region. In the bottom plot, the teal line (Llama-On-Policy-Hard) starts at 0.0, rises slightly to around 0.03 by step 50, then drops to near 0.0 by step 100 and remains flat thereafter. The red line (Llama-LUFFY-Hard) starts at 0.0, increases steadily to approximately 0.2 by step 500, with noticeable fluctuations and a shaded uncertainty region.
